subject: 河埠
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. ONE isolated transparent sprite for a realistic historical Chinese town game. Early-to-mid Qing NORTH CHINA, anonymous Beijing/Shengjing/Jinan architectural concept, not a specific monument reconstruction. Realistic traditional Chinese game sprite with fine natural weathered masonry, small tiled roofs, calm muted palette and believable structure. Qing northern grey-brick, grey-tile and dark timber. Orthographic DIMETRIC, yaw45 elevation30, STRICT 2:1 ground plane, east ground axis screen lower-right slope +0.5 and north upper-right slope -0.5, parallel lines NO perspective convergence. South doorway faces screen lower-left. Draw a thin rectangular ground boundary, entire footprint with visible left, front and right corners, NO thick floating base. Keep the entire sprite and soft contact shadow inside generous 10% transparent margins. TRUE transparent RGBA background. Absolutely NO ambient halo, NO glow, NO gradient floor or background of any kind. Alpha0 everywhere outside the exact object silhouette and its tiny contact shadow. Light from screen UPPER LEFT, short soft contact shadow lower-right. Grey fired brick, matte grey barrel tiles with straight sober ridges, northern hard-gable walls, dark brown wooden lattice windows, no Jiangnan whitewashed tourist style. No text, pseudo-writing, plaques, characters, people, flags, modern objects, sky, horizon, landscape, trees, water or road outside footprint, no saturated lighting, cartoon, plastic, borders or watermark. A low northern canal landing ONLY: grey stone rectangular quay with short descending steps at the south edge, timber mooring posts and low wooden unloading platform with a few bundled sacks. No building or roof, no boats, no water painted anywhere (water supplied by runtime), no surrounding bank, no thick pedestal. Exact ground footprint10m east-west by4m north-south; full front steps inside footprint. CRITICAL spacious transparent framing, entire object in central75% of canvas. Clean transparent PNG cutout, no halo.
negative: 文字、人物、水印、现代物、背景场景、厚地台、裁边、透视汇聚

projection_contract.note: 投影目标，不宣称生成图精确满足；实测见geometry_qa。

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize rounded to integer dimensions
paste without mask on transparent canvas, minimum 16px margins; no repaint/warp/flip/alpha threshold
crop alpha>0 bbox and restore transparent padding
